bible.text: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do we need to pray?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Do you think prayer is only about asking Me for things?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then what is prayer really about?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Prayer is a conversation with your Father. Come to Him honestly, even when you have no words.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When do you find it easiest to pray? Share your answer in the comments.
